description: The per-unit Frama-C/WP verification squeeze loop: it proves one C translation unit against ACSL contracts transcribed from an external requirement. Its upper bound is the requirement + the function prototypes/headers (terrain A transcription) plus the ACSL contracts authored upstream (terrain B); its lower bound is the WP machine: what actually discharges when frama-c -wp -wp-rte is run, plus the standing/formal tests and the non-vacuity mutation probe. Dominant coherent-and-wrong: a unit that PROVES yet is vacuous or wrong — a contract weakened to land, an Admitted/axiom/over-broad stub smuggled in, or a spec the verifier and annotator quietly agree on by reading the body. The load-bearing barrier is that the spec author and verifier never touch the implementation, and the annotator (the only actor that does) is barriered from the acceptance evidence.

disjointness.rationale: No actor holds both the spec it writes and the oracle that judges it. The spec author holds the requirement + prototypes (never the body, the scaffolding, or the tests) and is squeezed by WP-expressibility; the annotator is the only actor that touches the implementation but is barriered from the acceptance evidence and judged by fresh WP discharge against the contracts it did not write; the verifier holds the acceptance clauses + public surface (never the body or the annotator's diff) and is judged by what WP actually proves; the coordinator judges against U and the machine gates, never a producer's rationale. Structure (expressibility) is the spec author's, soundness of the proof is WP's, acceptance/non-vacuity is the verifier's — no single pair certifies the unit.
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: spec author ⊥ body AND verifier ⊥ body+diff; the annotator is the only actor that touches the implementation but is barriered from the acceptance evidence. If the spec author or verifier read the body, the spec collapses to body-mirroring and a PASS certifies self-consistency, not conformance.

catchability.blind_spot: writes a contract that mirrors an assumed body, or a vacuous/too-weak clause
catchability.via: the verifier's acceptance drivers + the non-vacuity mutation probe trip on a vacuous or body-shaped spec

catchability.blind_spot: weakens a contract / smuggles an Admitted/axiom/over-broad stub to make WP pass
catchability.via: the verifier re-runs -wp fresh against the acceptance clauses with red controls; a weakened contract fails the drivers or the mutation probe

catchability.blind_spot: writes a vacuous acceptance driver, or one that secretly assumes the body
catchability.via: the contracts are the verifier's U-anchor; a driver inconsistent with the authored contracts is caught at Gate A, and the spec author owns the surface it tests

catchability.blind_spot: rubber-stamps an unjudged plan or ends an item on a self-report
catchability.via: DONE is gated on the machine-gate output (fresh WP + tests + mutation), not a producer's say-so

catchability.blind_spot: mis-reads WP's behaviour / over-generalizes one experiment
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates probe verdicts at Gate A; the probe never implements a fix
